title: Tooltip above a button
summary: A position: absolute tooltip inside a position: relative wrapper, lifted above the trigger with top.
explanation: The wrapper is position: relative, so the tooltip is placed against it rather than the page. The tooltip itself is absolute, which takes it out of the flow, so the button does not move when the tooltip appears.
top: -40px lifts the tooltip above the button. z-index keeps it on top of content that comes later in the page. The tooltip is hidden by default; a real version would toggle it on hover or focus.
tryThis: Remove position: relative from .wrap: the tooltip jumps to the corner of the preview.
Change top to 40px: the tooltip now drops below the button instead of rising above it.
